purpose: Remove the failed activation dependency on an unprovisioned model-host SSH private key by reusing the already validated model token from the active local API runtime under the existing root-only REG.RU controller, while preserving rollback, exact-main authority and zero new recurring cost.
requiredBehavior: recover the model token only from the single active API container on the existing production host
validate the recovered token against the expected model base URL, model identity and private health endpoint
remove runner-supplied model transport metadata before production mutation begins
never require a separately provisioned model-host SSH key for exact-main activation
never reference or materialize a private model SSH key in GitHub Actions
run finalization only after activation successfully created release state
preserve activation trap rollback for failures after mutation begins
retain the non-root runner and restricted controller-only sudo authority
forbiddenCapabilities: private SSH key transport through GitHub Actions or repository secrets
model token output or artifact publication
